name: Fire Elemental
pageBasis: Printed and viewer page numbers coincide in this scan.

name: Fire Giant
pageBasis: Printed and viewer page numbers coincide in this scan.
evidence: Dorran uses class level 6 to have rock catching, with the 30-ft./1d6 rock attack. The class stays Medium through level 10. The encounter uses the class’s ordinary rocks and its fire subtype as printed.

name: Flesh Golem
pageBasis: Printed and viewer page numbers coincide in this scan.
evidence: Sedge has only spell resistance, since magic immunity begins at level 9. Use 3d10 with no Constitution modifier. The construct exception allowing natural healing and the absence of skill points are both explicit in this class.

name: Frost Giant
pageBasis: Printed and viewer page numbers coincide in this scan.
evidence: The published first Large tier is 11. Rocks stay at the level-10 damage and range until 14. Savage Species updates both energy subtypes in its introduction and gives the Frost equivalent in the cryo template. The greataxe is built using the book’s enlarged weapon table.

name: Ghaele
pageBasis: Printed and viewer page numbers coincide in this scan.
evidence: Ghaele 7 has 6 racial HD, caster level 7 for cleric casting and caster level 6 for lesser spell-like abilities. The class names five domains as additions to the normal spell list without granting domain slots, powers, or turn undead explicitly. The build uses its base and Wisdom bonus slots. The monster’s attack line clarifies that the 300-ft. light rays are ranged touch attacks. Treat the globe as lacking physical gear and natural armor while incorporeal. Armor Proficiency (Light) is a selected feat for the humanoid form’s chain shirt.
